note: GD.42 include-style mounts, Express. routes/users.js's `express.Router()` (exported by `module.exports = router`) is mounted by an inline `app.use('/svc/users', require('./routes/users'))`, routes/items.ts's `Router()` (`export default router`) by an imported name, `app.use('/svc/items', items)`, and a same-file router by `app.use('/svc/health', health)`; a middleware glob `app.use('/svc/*', ..)` mounts nothing and the app's own route keeps its path. The client calls non-`/api` prefixes, so only the mount pairs them. Baseline (pre-change CLI, glia 0.5.5+p1f568a19): ROUTEs `GET /list`, `POST /`, `GET /all`, `GET /ping`, `[http] paired=0`.
